texts: bad: "a single lantern" packs an exact count into a singular indefinite, and the translator has no count carrier there, so it slotted "single" as a description of the lantern - asserting the lantern is single rather than that the cove holds exactly one. Rewrite as "The Sunken Cove holds only one lantern.", which puts the count where the translator's exact-count machinery can take it (a lantern group counted at one) instead of in a property slot. The extra exclusive shade of "single"/"only" is a known unrepresented gap and will not be recorded either way, but the count itself then survives.

good. the definite plural becomes an iron_band group carrying the compound's genus (band), the named lantern gets one opaque symbol with its Name and kind atoms, and the reinforcing reaches each band through a fireable per-member rule while the group-level event stays queryable.
